cd cli && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go test -c -o TASK_TEMP/receiver-linux-arm64.test ./internal/assurance/receiver

result.validation: method, exact raw request URI, bearer, content type, body size, canonical JSON object shape, event_type, and authenticate-once ordering are enforced
result.ordering: the bounded receiver state machine is serialized; evidence sequence is assigned at processing start, so concurrent auth outcomes follow recorded order
result.knownCredentials: both generated receiver bearers are bound as exact known secrets and any body containing either is inconclusive before projection or digest
result.genericSecrets: the existing decision redactor produces only a canonical redacted projection and a digest of that projection when a generic secret is detected
result.nonSecretBodies: a valid non-secret request retains canonical projection metadata and an exact raw-request digest without retaining raw request bytes in the record
result.failures: malformed, duplicate-key, oversized, and redaction-failure bodies retain no projection or digest and are marked inconclusive; truncation records only the configured byte boundary
result.labels: caller attribution requires an exact bearer; methods and request URIs outside the closed vocabulary are stored only as unsupported
result.bounds: admission uses saturating counters before state serialization; each project/readiness budget retains at most one overflow record and later 429 responses neither queue nor grow evidence
result.sdkReplay: the fresh exact Mastra client again completed auth/evaluate through the loopback receiver and interpreted the immutable ALLOW response as continue
result.tests: focused count-25, race, affected-assurance, full CLI, vet, format, and Darwin/Linux/Windows compile-only checks passed
result.independentReview: approved the frozen six-file source/test hash set with no remaining high or medium SE-04-03 blocker and made no workspace or ledger writes

cleanup.preparedSdk: the source archive, private npm cache, installed dependencies, build output, and cross-compile outputs were moved to Trash
cleanup.sourceClone: the local openbox-mastra-sdk clone remained clean

limits: Request bodies exist as bounded in-memory bytes only while one serialized request is validated; returned records contain projections, digests, counts, categories, and closed labels, not raw request bytes or headers.
The default redactor is deterministic but cannot prove detection of every possible application secret. Exact receiver bearers are separately bound and rejected before hashing.
Records are persistence-ready receiver evidence. Audit-pack object writing and finalization remain later tasks; this task did not write request evidence into a finalized pack.
A normalized receiver event does not prove recordingTool identity, pre-effect gating, decision application, or side-effect prevention; later fixture, coverage, and judgment evidence own those claims.

The SDK replay is a direct local client/receiver observation, not a Mastra project launch, sandbox proof, provider/model call, production Core decision, BLOCK verdict, or external control-plane action.
Both Phase 03 sandbox tuples remain rejected, so this component proof does not make project execution runnable.
